calls.title: Riley Final Presentation
calls.summary: The meeting focused on the DevRel strategy emphasizing rapid onboarding through self-learning and community analysis, identifying gaps in documentation and user experience. Key initiatives include creating a public data playground, developing a recipe book with reusable code snippets, and establishing a video content cycle targeting developers, PMs, and data scientists. Segmenting content for different audiences will improve engagement, while measuring monthly active developers will assess impact. Operational efficiency is prioritized by limiting framework-specific tutorials to reduce maintenance burdens, ensuring high-quality content delivery.
calls.keywords: Developer Relations, Onboarding, Ecosystem Expansion, Community Engagement, Video Content, Metrics Tracking
calls.action_items:
**Riley Draward**
Develop a public playground app integrated with GrowthBook’s web app to enable live experimentation and dashboards, aimed at shortening time-to-value for users (11:30)
Create a recipe book containing experiment types and code snippets across multiple programming languages and stacks to support both human users and automated agents (13:50)
Establish a regular video content production cadence, targeting weekly releases that showcase product capabilities, agent workflows, and multi-language use cases, focusing on engagement rather than views (15:40)
Conduct user interviews with both large and small GrowthBook users to tailor content effectively for different audience roles including developers, product managers, and data scientists (20:45)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Coordinate collaboration opportunities between GrowthBook data scientists and engineers to produce joint content assets that leverage internal expertise and enhance content quality (37:10)
Set up candidate screening sessions and debrief meetings for upcoming candidates Philip and the late-entry senior developer educator from LaunchDarkly to finalize hiring decisions (40:46)

**Scott Bailey & Jeremy Dorn**
Assist in analyzing ecosystem usage data and prioritize language and framework support based on user feedback and developer surveys to optimize resource allocation (24:40)
Support identification and evaluation of effective community engagement tactics by analyzing metrics related to events, newsletters, social media, and Slack activity to enhance community growth (10:30)
